scope: Applied candidate source consumers and preparation key bindings. Static inspection only; this is not runtime qualification, conformance, Current proof evidence or performance acceptance.

restored_effects.ordering_observation: AIR, poly and expansion consumers use keyed get/index/contains_key; rebuilding the map loops over an already ordered SST function vector. No AIR emission iteration over the restored map was found.
Consumers index or get the exact datatype. Poly reconstructs the map from the ordered datatype vector; AIR datatype emission receives that vector separately.
Name allocation uses entry by exact stable id and name, not map iteration. The baseline encodes exact keyed contents; restoration does not independently reorder a function vector.
This is an ordered Vec, serialized and restored in order. The baseline also binds its ordered initial contents. Reporter iteration is over that Vec, not a newly seeded HashMap.
Quantifier metadata is inserted by qid and retrieved by qid in profiling/diagnostics. No AIR command-order iteration over this restored map was found.
The per-function counter is accessed with entry(fun_name); restored key/value contents, not hash iteration order, determine subsequent qids.
Functions are looked up/indexed by exact name. The static-function emission filter iterates a separate ordered function collection and performs keyed predicate lookup.
These maps detect hash collisions using insertion of exact encoded string/byte contents. They do not enumerate restored entries to emit AIR declarations.

ordered_consumers.ordering_source: Ctx.functions Vec, built fresh from the pruned Krate.functions Vec. SailEffects does not replace this Vec. Ordered reveal_groups are separate and preserved.
ordered_consumers.key_binding: The entire exact typed pruned Krate is encoded in bucket_key; the standalone baseline's omission of Ctx.functions is redundant for this field because Ctx::new copies that exact Krate vector before key calculation.

ordered_consumers.ordering_source: KrateSst.functions Vec. Lowering builds this Vec by ordered call-graph SCC groups; poly maps it in order. A prepared hit returns that ordered vector.
ordered_consumers.key_binding: FunctionOrder ledger records selected input Vec and complete ordered Vec<Vec<Fun>> answer; hit validation recomputes and compares the ordered answer before restoring the SST.

ordered_consumers.consumer: Spec definitions and proof operation schedule
ordered_consumers.ordering_source: Fresh GlobalCtx.call_graph_all_sccs and call_graph_scc_nodes, then an ordered local scc_functions Vec. OpGenerator's maps are keyed lookup tables created from the supplied SST; the operation queue itself is freshly generated after a cache hit.
ordered_consumers.key_binding: Prepared graph reads are checked before restoration; full AIR scheduling is not restored from a cached operation queue. GlobalCtx.func_call_graph and func_call_sccs are not SailEffects fields.

conclusion: The inspected code does not demonstrate arrow declaration/definition reordering caused by fresh HashMap seeds in SailEffects restoration. This excludes that specific proposed mechanism, not every possible preparation defect. Cross-process stock self-differences and an empty-prepared control must remain distinct from a same-input cache causality test.

recommended_same_input_oracle.scope: Design feedback only; not implemented or executed by this audit.
recommended_same_input_oracle.inputs: One compiler callback's exact immutable pruned Krate, initial typed state, source/span owners and ordered graph answers.
arms: Decode and restore one genuine prepared artifact
Perform fresh lowering of those exact same inputs
recommended_same_input_oracle.independent_state: Reconstruct independent Ctx::new values and independent mutable graph capture/chosen/qid owners. Do not merely clone Ctx: NameCtxt::clone aliases Rc<RefCell<NameCtxtImpl>> and could let the first arm's naming decisions contaminate the second.
recommended_same_input_oracle.comparison: Ordered SST vectors and exact resulting AIR/SMT command bytes under the same fresh graph schedule; no sorting or normalization of solver inputs.
